audits.title: 759 Lost in Translation: Breast Surgery Pathology Reporting Audit
audits.standard: RCPath dataset for pathology reporting of breast disease in surgical excision specimens: 90% of reports to include items
audits.setting: Breast unit, Ashford and St Peter's Hospital

cycle1.result: Specimen type, histological grade and invasive disease well reported; date of surgery 0%, core biopsy site 1.5%, microinvasion 4.3%.

audits.other_findings: Prompted by a serious incident; a streamlined reporting proforma with RCPath core items is proposed.
audits.citation: Szepietowski O, Cope P, Blacker S, Anbhalagan V, Lawn A, Kothari M. 759 Lost in Translation: Breast Surgery Pathology Reporting Audit. British Journal of Surgery. 2024;111(Supplement_6). doi:10.1093/bjs/znae163.262.

audits.title: An audit of breast cancer pathology reporting in Australia in 1995.
audits.standard: Recommended items in breast cancer pathology reports (before Australian Cancer Network recommendations)

cycle1.result: Only 28% of invasive cancer reports had all recommended information; histological type 99.6%, tumour size 94%, margins 87%, grade 84%, DCIS 79%, vessel invasion 61%.

audits.other_findings: DCIS reports rarely gave size (49%), necrosis (41%) or nuclear grade (39%); 69% of pathologists issued fewer than two reports a month.
audits.citation: Kricker A, Armstrong B, Smith C, Bilous M, Camaris C, Mayer A, et al.. An audit of breast cancer pathology reporting in Australia in 1995. Br J Cancer. 1999;80(3-4):563-568. doi:10.1038/sj.bjc.6690392. PMID: 10408867.

audits.title: Improving the quality of surgical pathology reports for breast cancer: a centralized audit with feedback.
audits.standard: 7 diagnostic elements chosen by a pathologist committee as essential in the surgical pathology report
audits.setting: Quebec hospitals performing 20 or more segmental breast resections for cancer
audits.intervention: Centralised surveillance with feedback of results to hospitals.
audits.citation: Onerheim R, Racette P, Jacques A, Gagnon R. Improving the quality of surgical pathology reports for breast cancer: a centralized audit with feedback. Arch Pathol Lab Med. 2008;132(9):1428-1431. doi:10.5858/2008-132-1428-itqosp. PMID: 18788854.

audits.title: Histopathology of breast carcinoma--an audit of 50 reports in Rawalpindi, Pakistan.
audits.setting: Histopathology Department, Armed Forces Institute of Pathology, Rawalpindi

cycle1.result: In situ component commented on in 23.2%; necrosis in 35%; tabular format in 36%.

audits.other_findings: Checklist formats for different specimen types recommended.
audits.citation: Mamoon N, Hassan U, Mushtaq S, Sharif MA. Histopathology of breast carcinoma--an audit of 50 reports in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. Asian Pac J Cancer Prev. 2010;11(1):169-172. PMID: 20593952.

audits.title: Audit of histopathology reports for breast cancer in Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital.
audits.standard: Six set audit criteria for mastectomy histopathology reports
audits.setting: Pathology laboratory, Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital

cycle1.result: Tumour size 50%, macroscopic margin 62%, tumour type 92%, grade 40%, lymphovascular invasion 12%, microscopic margin 64%; only 3 (2.2%) met all six.

audits.other_findings: Average turnaround time 15.8 days; standard report formats recommended.
audits.citation: Atanda AT, Atanda JO. Audit of histopathology reports for breast cancer in Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital. West Afr J Med. 2010;29(3):174-177. doi:10.4314/wajm.v29i3.68216. PMID: 20665461.

audits.title: Improving diagnostic standards: a two-cycle clinical audit on core biopsy reports adherence to international guidelines for breast lesions.
audits.standard: Royal College of Pathologists minimum dataset for breast biopsy reports

cycle1.result: Hormone receptor (ER, PR) and HER2 reporting 67.1% compliance; high compliance for patient profile and some pathological findings.

audits.intervention: Targeted training and a standardised reporting template.

cycle2.result: ER, PR and HER2 reporting 80.2% compliance; improvements in B category use, histological typing and overall dataset adherence.

audits.citation: Hamza HM, Tariq MD, Ahsan A, Sarfraz T, Malik MM, Aneeqa S, et al.. Improving diagnostic standards: a two-cycle clinical audit on core biopsy reports adherence to international guidelines for breast lesions. Ann Med Surg (Lond). 2025;87(8):4853-4860. doi:10.1097/ms9.0000000000003470. PMID: 40787496.
